children: Broadwind's revenue rose 47.9% year over year, while earnings shifted to a loss from income. Higher shipments to new and aftermarket gas turbine customers lifted Industrial Solutions revenue 32%; Gearing revenue rose 36% on increased shipments across markets. Earnings also reflected the absence of the $8.2M gain on sale recorded a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “NET (LOSS) INCOME”. ³ Reported as “Net (loss) income”.
: Continuing-operations orders were $33.7M, up from $29.9M; Industrial Solutions orders rose 42% on demand from new gas turbine projects.
: Orders fell 38%, mainly because a significant prior-year natural gas turbine OEM order did not recur; operating profitability improved by $672K.
: Operating income increased to $1.3M from $445K, primarily on higher sales and improved capacity utilization.
: Broadwind acquired MCM on October 30 for approximately $21.5M in cash, including $3.5M deposited into escrow.
